evals.prompt: The PRD at docs/prd/inventory.md is approved. Design the database schema for it.
evals.expected_output: An entity list derived from PRD user stories, an engine recommendation with reasoning, and a schema document with columns, relationships, indexes, constraints, and migration notes
expectations: Entities are derived from PRD user stories or objectives rather than invented
The database engine is proposed with a recommendation and a reason, or explicitly inherited from the PRD
Every foreign key declares cardinality and on-delete behaviour
Every index names the query it serves
The user approves the model before the schema document is written
